blurb: Renegade Fishing Charters is a father and son team operating on Lake Michigan from Winthrop Harbor, IL. They offer guided fishing trips focusing on Salmon and Trout. The captains are fully licensed by the U.S. Coast Guard and have over 40 years of combined fishing experience.
